item.title: CJEM is Returning to Print
item.description: You asked, we listened. Back by popular demand: the CJEM print edition! The return to print will begin with the September DOUBLE SIZED issue. To ensure you receive your copy login to and verify your mailing address by clicking “Profile Information.” If you are not currently a member you can login at the same location and click the “Renew today” button and then “REGISTER” in the top menu bar. If you have any questions or comments or have forgotten your password, please contact cbova@caep.ca. Rega

item.title: A Message from The President
item.description: Dear Colleagues, As we approach the end of the year, I want to extend the CAEP Board’s gratitude and appreciation for your tireless efforts to improve the emergency care we give to patients across this country. Our work is primarily delivered in chaotic and crowded EDs, but increasingly includes prehospital care, public health and policy, research, leadership and a raft of subspecialty niches. item.title: Remembering: Dr. Edmond Monaghan
item.description: Dr Edmond Monaghan September 4, 1929 – April 24, 2020 All physicians who work in emergency medicine in Québec and Canada are connected to Dr Edmond Monaghan. He was a leader and a pioneer who established the first training program in Emergency Medicine in Canada, in 1972, at the Royal Victoria Hospital in Montreal.
